verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is an online IP-filing service that holds user application data, so a data-export-and-leave story is a fair question. The evidence pack only covers filing, amending, withdrawing (desistência) and obtaining title certificates. There is no documented bulk export of user data in open formats. Withdrawing an application or requesting a title document is an adjacent feature, not data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
